statement: The Central Pollution Control Board daily bulletin reports a 24-hour average air quality index of 401 or higher for Delhi on at least one day between 2026-11-07 and 2026-11-15.
resolution: At least one CPCB daily AQI bulletin dated between 2026-11-07 and 2026-11-15 lists a 24-hour average AQI of 401 or higher, the severe category, for Delhi.
failure_condition: The CPCB 24-hour average AQI for Delhi stays at 400 or lower on every day from 2026-11-07 through 2026-11-15.

statement: Donald Trump, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin hold a dedicated in-person three-leader meeting between 2026-11-14 and 2026-11-22.
resolution: An official readout from the White House, the Kremlin or the Chinese Foreign Ministry confirms a dedicated three-leader meeting of Trump, Xi and Putin, separate from any multilateral summit session, held in person between 2026-11-14 and 2026-11-22.
failure_condition: No dedicated in-person meeting of all three leaders takes place between 2026-11-14 and 2026-11-22.

statement: The Alaska Division of Elections publishes a final-round ranked-choice tabulation or certified result between 2026-11-18 and 2026-12-04 showing Mary Peltola defeating incumbent Dan Sullivan for US Senate.
resolution: Results published by the Alaska Division of Elections between 2026-11-18 and 2026-12-04, either the final-round ranked-choice tabulation or the certified result, show Mary Peltola with more votes than incumbent Dan Sullivan for US Senate.
failure_condition: By 2026-12-04 the Alaska Division of Elections has issued no final-round tabulation or certified result in which Mary Peltola has more votes than incumbent Dan Sullivan.

statement: Authorities in at least one European country announce the arrest or charging of a suspect for sending bomb threats against European flights or airports, with the announcement made between 2026-11-07 and 2026-12-05.
resolution: European police or prosecutors announce, between 2026-11-07 and 2026-12-05, the arrest or charging of a person suspected of sending bomb threats made since 2026-11-01 against European flights or airports, per two of Reuters, AP, AFP, BBC.
failure_condition: No European authority arrests or charges anyone for sending bomb threats against European flights or airports between 2026-11-07 and 2026-12-05.

statement: The Federal Open Market Committee raises the target range for the federal funds rate at its scheduled meeting concluding on 2026-12-09.
resolution: FRED series DFEDTARU shows a higher value for 2026-12-10 than for 2026-11-06, reflecting a target range increase announced in the Federal Reserve statement of 2026-12-09.
failure_condition: The federal funds target range in effect on 2026-12-10 is the same as or lower than the range in effect on 2026-11-06.

statement: ICE Brent crude front-month futures settle below 90.00 dollars per barrel on 2026-12-11. Reference: 97.09 on the packet date.
resolution: The ICE Brent front-month futures settlement price for 2026-12-11 is below 90.00 dollars per barrel. Reference: 97.09 on the packet date.
failure_condition: ICE Brent front-month futures settle at or above 90.00 dollars per barrel on 2026-12-11.

statement: The S&P 500 closes below 7,000.00 on at least one trading day between 2026-11-09 and 2026-12-18. Reference: 7,405.12 on the packet date.
resolution: At least one official S&P 500 daily close between 2026-11-09 and 2026-12-18 inclusive, per S&P Dow Jones Indices or FRED series SP500, is below 7,000.00. Reference: 7,405.12 on the packet date.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 closes at or above 7,000.00 on every trading day from 2026-11-09 through 2026-12-18.

statement: The United States and Iran both officially confirm a concluded agreement that includes reopening the Strait of Hormuz to commercial shipping, announced between 2026-11-09 and 2026-12-20.
resolution: Official statements from both the US and Iranian governments, reported by at least two of Reuters, AP and AFP, confirm a concluded agreement that includes reopening the Strait of Hormuz, announced between 2026-11-09 and 2026-12-20.
failure_condition: The two governments do not both confirm a concluded agreement that includes reopening the Strait of Hormuz between 2026-11-09 and 2026-12-20.

statement: The US House of Representatives elects Hakeem Jeffries as Speaker in a roll call vote held between 2027-01-03 and 2027-01-15.
resolution: The Clerk of the House roll call for election of the Speaker of the 120th Congress, held between 2027-01-03 and 2027-01-15, records Hakeem Jeffries as elected Speaker.
failure_condition: The House does not elect Hakeem Jeffries as Speaker in any roll call held from 2027-01-03 through 2027-01-15.

statement: CISA adds an OpenSSH vulnerability to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a date-added value between 2026-11-07 and 2027-01-29.
resolution: The CISA KEV catalog carries at least one entry whose vendorProject or product field names OpenSSH and whose dateAdded value falls between 2026-11-07 and 2027-01-29 inclusive.
failure_condition: CISA adds no OpenSSH vulnerability to the KEV catalog with a date-added value from 2026-11-07 through 2027-01-29.
